name: @opm/agent-gui
description: OPM agent GUI (Svelte 5 SPA served by the Go agent at /_opm/, embedded with go:embed)

scripts.dev: node scripts/vendor-xterm.mjs && node scripts/vendor-codemirror.mjs && vite dev
scripts.dev:mock: node scripts/vendor-xterm.mjs && node scripts/vendor-codemirror.mjs && VITE_MOCK=1 vite dev
scripts.build: node scripts/vendor-xterm.mjs && node scripts/vendor-codemirror.mjs && svelte-kit sync && vite build
scripts.build:mock: node scripts/vendor-xterm.mjs && node scripts/vendor-codemirror.mjs && VITE_MOCK=1 OPM_GUI_OUT=build-mock vite build
